articleTitle: An Introductory Approach to Spectral Image Analysis Using Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Machine learning approach in the field of spectral image analysis has achieved remarkable results. Machine learning techniques are the most appealing method for the analysis of spectral pictures because of the high dimensionality of spectral images and the scarcity of annotated data. In this paper, a basic implementation of machine learning classifiers for hyperspectral imaging is presented. It discusses on the preprocessing of hyperspectral images using unsupervised algorithms and performing the classification with supervised ones. This article aims to pique data scientists' curiosity in using cutting-edge machine learning models on their own hyperspectral dataset.

articleTitle: A Universal Controller for Grid-Forming Inverters in Microgrid during Islanding for Low Transient Current
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: A universal controller to reduce the transient current during islanding of microgrid is presented in this paper. In the proposed universal controller, two sets of semi-parallel paths are formed. One set produces the PWM references for grid-following (GFL) mode, and the other produces the PWM references for the grid-forming (GFM) mode for the inverters. Herein, the controller enables an inverter to universally operate in GFL and GFM mode, whereas only one set of voltage and phase-angle references is engaged for PWM signal generation. The universal controller switches the voltage and phase-angle references from GFL to GFM mode during islanding of the microgrid. The proposed controller ensures lower transient current by keeping the two sets of semi-parallel paths synchronized throughout the operation of the inverter and enabling a seamless transition between the modes. The proposed controller is verified through hardware experiments under different scenarios in a laboratory-scale microgrid for inverters transitioning from GFL to GFM mode after islanding.

articleTitle: An Optimised Deep Learning Approach of Lane Detection in Complex Indian Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Lane detection systems are useful to avoid road accidents that are due to wrong-lane driving. Such systems have the target to detect the lanes and warn the driver in case the vehicle enters the wrong lane. In this paper, we've proposed a lane detection technique that increases the accuracy and stability of the vehicle while tracing the position of the lane in a complex driving environment. Based on the existing methods like Canny edge detection and the Hough transform method, the proposed technique has an excellent detection ability and can detect key lanes in complex road environments such as darkness, traffic jams, and uneven lighting.

articleTitle: ASMBoT: An Intelligent Sanitizing Robot in the Coronavirus Outbreak
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Technology plays a vital role in our lives to meet basic hygiene necessities. Currently, the whole world is facing an epidemic situation and the practice of using sanitizers is common nowadays. Sanitizers are used by people to sanitize their hands and bodies. It is also used for sanitizing objects that come into contact with the machine. While sanitizing a small area, people manage to sanitize via pumps, but it becomes difficult to sanitize the same area every day. One of the most severe sanitation concerns is a simple, economic and efficient method to adequately clean the indoor and outdoor environments. In particular, effective sanitization is required for people working in a clinical environment. Recently, some commonly used sanitizer techniques include electric sanitizer spray guns, electric sanitizer disinfectants, etc. However, these sanitizers are not automated, which means a person is required to roam personally with the device to every place to spray the disinfectant or sanitize an area. Therefore, a novel, cost-effective automatic sanitizing machine (ASM) named ASMBoT is designed that can dispense the sanitizer effectively by solving the aforementioned problems.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Dual Third Order Generalized Integrator based Phase Locked Loop for Three Phase Distorted Grid Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The growing integration of Distributed power generation systems (DPGS) with the three phase power systems especially through power electronics-based voltage source converters (VSCs) is recently receiving considerable attention. To this end, a typical synchronous reference frame phase locked loop (SRF PLL) used for synchronization of the VSCs with the electric power network ensures in obtaining the amplitude, phase angle and frequency information same as the grid. The SRF PLL due to it's limited filtering ability is practically unsuitable for most of the applications. Dealing with this only SRF PLL's drawback, a large amount of advanced three phase PLLs have been suggested in the literature. Among them, Dual Third Order Generalized Integrator (DTOGI) PLL is an appropriate synchronization method for precise and quick determination of the utility voltage phase angle. In this paper, the DTOGI PLL is analysed and simulated in MATLAB/Simulink with respect to the most widely used Dual Second Order Generalized Integrator (DSOGI) PLL under various distorted grid conditions like sag with harmonics and variable frequency showing DTOGI PLL as an effective solution for synchronizing the interactive inverter of three phase grid with DPGS.

articleTitle: Power Loss Estimation of Isolated Coupled Inductor based Dual Active Bridge Converter using GaN Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The interleaved coupled inductor-based dual active bridge (CIDAB) converters are capable to improve the efficiency over a wide range of loads as compared to conventional dual active bridge (DAB) converters. Using the traditional phase-shifting control method, this study examines the power losses of the CIDAB converter in forwarding mode i.e. low to high voltages, and reverse mode i.e. high to low voltages power flow operations. The silicon (Si) and gallium nitride (GaN) switching devices are considered for this analysis and their characteristics are extracted from the datasheet. The goal of this work is to create a power loss model which can be utilized in estimating the power losses of the CIDAB converter using GaN semiconductor devices and to compare it to the current literature. Further, the simulation studies are performed through the MATLAB software and the results are discussed. It is observed that the GaN-based CIDAB converter is in great competition with the existing similar topologies.

articleTitle: Storage Essentiality in Solar PV Incorporated Grid Connected System Estimating its Lifespan
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The presentation of a sunlight based photovoltaic framework with and without a battery energy stockpiling gadget is investigated in this examination (BESS). The predominance of the capacity based framework is explored and assessed, with the battery's normal life term. At the point when the innovation is put through a lot of hardship, the examination will be fittingly checked. The dynamic force, responsive force, current and voltage at the reason behind normal coupling (PCC) are thought about between the sun powered PV-based organization and the sun based PV with energy stockpiling framework during a flaw. At long last, the battery's normal life expectancy has been determined utilizing a stochastic method. In the MATLAB/SIMULINK climate, the whole framework is displayed, approved, and surveyed.

articleTitle: Linear Bottle filling system using Simatic S7-200 and S7-1200 PLC with HMI control
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The paper focuses on designing, developing, coordinating and tracking of “Linear bottle filling system using Siemens S7-200 PLC”. PLC is used as the primary control, which is linked to Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) to control and monitor the processes on a PC using Siemens remote communication interface with an Open Process Control (OPC) network. This is project highlights industrial automation, with application in milk industry, oil, water, chemical, paints and several industrial packaging industries. A model has been designed to demonstrate the process. In a PLC simulation software, the system was implemented. It was then evaluated in a hardware prototype. The results of the tests confirmed that it could be used in the actual world without modifying the original code.

articleTitle: Face Recognition based Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In today's world, taking student attendance in schools and colleges is a very significant duty for the faculty. If the faculty takes attendance physically, it wastes a lot of time. Hence, we have been taking the help of technology. This will play a vital role in enlightening the excellence of the educational system. Taking attendance physically takes a lot of time and effort. For the faculty to maintain and manage the attendance sheet is very boring work and it costs time from the lectures. The smart and computerized attendance system can help manage attendance. It will help to instigate using several ways of biometric. Face recognition is unique and the most famous technology nowadays. This new technology helps to replace the old traditional sheets. via this model, the problem of forged attendance and proxies can be cracked. In the old system, students just punch the card and then don't go to class. The proposed work that monitors the real-time attendance of the students. The Proposed work defines the effective algorithm that helps to mark attendance inevitably without human involvement. The most important step in this system is to detect the faces and recognize them. When we can talk about a comparison of the traditional attendance and currently proposed system, that we have seen the current system help to monitor the student attendance more properly. This system will be actual help to maintain the attendance and help faculty to record the students.

articleTitle: Modelling of Dynamic Fuzzy-PID based Speed Controller for BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In recent year the demand of Permanent magnet brushless DC motors (PMBLDC) has been increased in robotics, industrial etc due to developed high performance with variable speed control. To have an effective control over starting and running condition a model of PMBLDC has been built in a MATLAB/SIMULINK-based platform using mathematical expressions derived from motor functioning principles. The rotor speed, stator current, back emf, gate pulse, and electromagnetic torque have been examined from a simulation model to study the behaviour, performance, and control strategy of Brushless DC motor. Generally PID controllers were used to regulate the motor, due to the presence of non-linearities the conventional controller doesn't give satisfactory performances. A fuzzy logic-based PID controller is employed in this paper to presize the motor speed regulation. Also a comparative study of the conventional auto tunned PID controller with Fuzzy-PID controller has been conducted at different load conditions in MATLAB/SIMULINK enviroment.

articleTitle: Serverless Implementation of Data Wizard Application using Azure Kubernetes Service and Docker
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Several providers in the cloud provide server-less solutions that claim to be highly available, scalable, and low-maintenance. To that end, serverless computing using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Dockers is promoted as a feasible choice for pay-per-use Web API, data processing, and backend services. They offer elastic and automated scalability, in contrast to VMs, by automatically provisioning and allocating resources. We provide our findings from analyzing the Data Wizard application running on AKS and as Function(s)-as-a-Service, a serverless solution (FaaS). We compare these rollouts by moving data between generations of Azure to track latencies and costs. When VMs are prepared for the anticipated load, and test scenarios are within the FaaS hardware constraints, we discovered no major changes in response time between deployments. FaaS easily manages larger data migration volumes, but VMs require more man hours to get the same outcomes. The benefits of serverless computing, as we've seen them, make it easy to decide between serverless and virtual machines for a Data Wizard (DW) programme.

articleTitle: Novel Control Scheme for PV-Wind-Battery based Water Pumping System Driven by PMDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Water supply from underground through pumps is playing important role in human's life. Renewable energy sources based water pumping systems can help to reduce demand on utility grid as well as can also provide continuous water supply to consumers by designing proper sizing of hybrid system. The photovoltaic (PV) and wind are mostly available renewable energy sources in the world. However, the integration of PV and wind cannot provide reliable supply since both are depending on nature and even there is no solar irradiance during night time or cloudy time. Hence, integration of batteries can make system more reliable and also can maintain stable power supply to an electrical motor for driving water pump. There is an enough space to install PV and wind systems on apartments as well as on overhead water tanks available in many rural or some places in urban cities. In such places, installing a PV, wind, and battery operated water pumping system can give many advantages. However, proper energy management coordination system is required among PV, wind, battery, motor, and pump for an effective operation. The centralized energy management system is designed in this paper to make a proper coordination among all the components involved in this system. In order to minimize losses, Permanent Magnet Direct Current (PMDC) generator is considered for generating electrical power through wind turbine and PMDC motor is used to drive the pump. Individual maximum power point tracker (MPPT) converters are connected to PV and wind to enhance maximum utilization. These two MPPT converters are connected to common dc-link. The battery is incorporated to dc-link through bidirectional dc-dc converter. The bidirectional dc-dc converter can maintain constant dc-link voltage to operate PMDC motor at its maximum efficiency level. Extensive results are presented based on Hardware-in-Loop provided by OPAL-RT units.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Inrush Current Mitigation in Islanded Microgrids Powered by Grid-Forming Inverters
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Grid-forming inverters in a microgrid may trip due to high inrush current caused by a switched connection of an inductive load, e.g., a relatively large induction motor. The control scheme presented in this article includes virtual inertia control method superimposed on the cascaded controller. This article studies the impact of cascaded control scheme used for grid-forming inverter to mitigate the inrush current effects and enhance the inverter's robustness for the safe connection of inductive and dynamic loads. Experimental tests are performed using the virtual inertia method for generating the reference angle for synchronous frame conversion. The experimental performance and sensitivity of the controller to different controller gain settings for a switched connection of an induction motor are discussed. The cascaded operation significantly mitigates the inrush currents while the inverters can perform a normal operation. The performance of the control method is tested in a laboratory-scale hardware setup of a 208V microgrid fed by 5kVA and 10kVA inverters, and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cascading Failures in the Study of Power System Resiliency
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Most transmission lines are at present heavily overburdened due to the deregulated environment. The more stressed the lines are, the more vulnerable they are to extreme natural catastrophes, and if they fail, the line flows of comparatively less stressed lines are hampered. The initialization of a cascading situation is crucial to take into account when discussing resilience because it is one of the effects of the power system on high-impact low-frequency events. The system's line with the largest power flow among all the lines is purposefully left off in this analysis to assess the resiliency of the system. Due to this line discarding, the MATPOWER extension platform detects the spread of cascading failure and islanding formation. Four metrics have been thoroughly compared between the two scenarios, with and without removing the lines. This reveals that the lines with significant higher power flows are vulnerable and can disrupt the system's other components.

articleTitle: FOPID controller for Load Frequency Control of Hybrid Power System under Deregulated regime using Improved Firefly Algorithm (IFA)
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The proposed work primarily focuses on keeping frequency fluctuations and Tie-Line (TL) power exchange with area control error (ACE) within acceptable limits when subjected to various load changes. Electricity sector deregulation has resulted in the development of new enterprises for power generation, transmission, and distribution. Deregulation produces a highly competitive and dispersed control environment, making load frequency control (LFC) considerably more difficult when wind turbines are included in the system. Because oscillation damping is required for better system performance with frequency and tie-line power fluctuations, proper tuning of Fractional Order PID (FO-PID) controllers is critical. A new Improved Firefly Algorithm (IFA) has been developed and used for tuning different parameters of the controllers installed in each area by minimizing the Integral Time Multiplied by Absolute Error (ITAE) performance index as an objective function to improve the performance of the FOPID controller. Different operating scenarios were created and tested in MATLAB/SIMULINK to evaluate the usefulness of the suggested controller concept for various power agreements between GENCOs and DISCOs, such as Poolco and Bilateral power contracts. To validate the resilience and efficacy of the IFA-driven FOPID controller, a comparison is made in terms of overshoot/undershoot and settling time for all variables under various operating changes with the previously described Firefly algorithm and PSO-based FOPID controllers.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled -Cloud based Smart Parking System for 5G Service
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Locating parking spots for automobiles is a significant issue in many large, overcrowded cities. We propose in this article the design and implementation of a true intelligent parking system using IoT technologies and mobile applications. This could provide more than just information on available spaces; it might also assist the user in locating the best spot for parking the vehicle in effort to reduce congestion in the parking lot. Additionally, we utilize IoT technology to save all information on a cloud system, allowing for highly easy management and storage of all data pertaining to cars and available parking space in the parking lot. Virtually 5G is seamlessly connecting a massive number of embedded sensors providing lean and low-cost connectivity solutions, where everything, everyone including objects, machines and devices are connected. This cloud-based solution would simplify store data and transfer between various PCs in the workspace. The design will enhance the entire smart parking system, facilitating vehicle management and data storage physically connecting the 5G network for better service from the industries.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of solar flat plate collector: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Thermal energy may be created from solar energy and used for many purposes. Utilizing a solar flat plate collector to capture heat energy is one of the most suitable techniques. The purpose of a solar collector is to warm air by using ambient temperature. The heated air are used in a variety of applications, including household, industrial, and crop production and management. Some disadvantages of solar air collectors are low thermal efficiency. Improved solar air heater efficiency should be accompanied by increased heat uptake from moving air and decreased heat losses to the surrounding environment. Because of this, the current effort aims to decrease the total surface-loss heat transfer coefficient and increase in collector efficiency. In order to make the system more efficient, a double-glazing system has been implemented, by adjusting the space between the absorber plate and glass plate (glass 1 and 2). This article conducted a comparison of two solar air collectors. The efficiency of the collector is improved more by recovering heat losses from the glass cover than by doubling the glass cover, according to the result. The efficiency of the collector, however, varies depending on the sun intensity, radiative heat transfer coefficient, wind speed, and convective heat transfer coefficient.

articleTitle: GHG Impact Analysis on the Performance of Solar PV Output using SVM Kernel Debugging
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Day ahead forecasting of solar PV plant will enable the market operator to participate in the spot market. Increase in greenhouse gas concentration such as COx, NOx and SOx in the air is also affecting the performance of solar PV (SPV) performance not directly but indirectly. The decrease in solar concentration due to the interaction of GHG has a direct relationship on the performance of SPV output. In order to investigate this effect, here the author has made an attempt to show the impact of GHG concentration on solar PV performance using MATLAB program. Disturbance in solar irradiance has been given as an input as a function of GHG concentration. All the results were validated using experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Forest Fire Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Forest is a complex ecological system that plays a very vital role from environmental point of view due to its flora and fauna. Covering one-third of the earth's land area, it performs various tasks across the globe. Forest ecosystems provide shelter for animals and birds, are responsible for climate stabilization, and provide food, water, wood, and herbal medicines etc. . Despite, all these benefits, forest fire has been a growing concern over the years. According to the recent wildfire statistics, there have been a total of 1065 large wildfires happened. The main 3 elements that playa major role in combustion are heat, oxygen, and fuel that is already present in abundant in the forest These three elements together are known as the fire triangle. When the temperature rises in the forest and there is less humidity and a windy breeze, there are maximum chances of fire taking place due to the tree barks and dry leaves which are the most combustible substances. By any chance, if the forest fire can be detected at its earlier stage, then it is possible for the forest officials to come up with a solution for its prevention and stopping any kind of massive destruction that may happen to the flora and fauna of the forest The forestry monitoring system designed by us mainly focuses not only on the day-to-day changes taking place in the forest, but also alerts the forest officials before the wildfire starts.

articleTitle: Real-Time Dog Detection and Alert System using Tensorflow Lite Embedded on Edge Device
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Wild and domestic animals constitute a massive part of the animal kingdom. There are approximately 8.7 million different species of animal available. Still, many species are being discovered. Cats and dogs are the most common animal in the society where people live and work. Human beings are also social animals who know society's living norms. However, animals like dogs and cats are not aware of the rules and norms to be followed in society. Hence it is necessary to keep track of the animals in the restricted areas to avoid sudden death, which happens accidentally. So, this paper proposed a real-time dog detection model with email notifications using Embedded ML running on Raspberry Pi for the University campus. Machine learning models like SSD, YOLO v3, and YOLO v4 are used to detect the dog and send the notification to the concerned authority. It has been found that the YOLO v3 model outperforms all other models with the highest accuracy of 94%, whereas SSD and YOLO v4 Achieved an accuracy of 89% and 63%, respectively.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of different types of solar collector for solar air dryer: A review
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The extensive and unpredictable rise in energy demand with economic development has increased the pollution level and limited the availability of conventional nonrenewable energy sources. Sustainable energy sources like solar energy are utilised for heating purposes, which is free and environmentally friendly. Solar air collectors with various advancements have been developed which utilise solar energy for heating air, which is reported in this review paper. This review discusses the mechanism and advancements in the solar air collector used for air heating, which is an imperative integrant of the solar dryer. This paper mainly aims at the solar air collector of rectangular box type and flat plate designs with some modifications. The methods and modifications used for the analysis and performance enhancement are reported in this review. Results are also summarised on the basis of theoretical and experimental performance studies. Performance is compared based on the efficiency of the collector. Different types of collectors are categorised and illustrated. This review paper provides insight into the findings and benefits of improvement in solar air collectors to animate additional thermoeconomic development towards the furtherance of progressive development.

articleTitle: On Projection of Safe Operation for Grid-Following Inverters - Grid Parameter Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This work investigates the projection of safe operation for grid-following inverters using a reference model. This work applies recursive-least square and model reference adaptive estimation techniques to estimate the unknown grid parameters. The estimated grid parameters are used in a dynamic reference model to project the safe operation of the inverter. This work also demonstrates that the controller nonlinearity and parameter variations can cause unsafe operations, such as unexpected instability at low power levels, namely hidden mode of instability. This instability issue in the nominal operating range may occur for given control parameters in a weak-grid condition. The dynamic reference model for PQ-controlled inverters is applied to analyze this instability issue using the estimated grid parameters. Both adaptive identification techniques can estimate the unknown parameters accurately, and the dynamic reference model can safeguard inverters from an unsafe operation, i.e., hidden instability, by examining the incoming new power set-points before engaging them to the local controller. The findings are experimentally verified using a small-scale two-level 208 V, 5 kVA inverter feeding a grid emulator.

articleTitle: Implementation of Multi Bit Error Detection and Correction using Low Density Parity Check Codes
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Data transmission in advanced space communications are suffering with the different types of noises. Further, these noises cause burst errors in data. Thus, the low-density parity checking codes (LDPC) plays the major role to detect and correct the errors. However, the conventional hamming encoders, decoders were detected and corrected only one bit error. Therefore, this work implementation the Multi-Bit Error Detection and Correction Codes (MBE-DCC) for multiple bits error detection and correction. Initially, MBE-DCC encoding operation is implemented by using generator matrix, which contains both identity bits and parity bits. Then, encoded code word is transmitted into the channel of space communication, where encoded data corrupted by different types of noises, errors. Therefore, the MBE-DCC decoding operation performed at receiver side of space communications, which corrected all the errors using syndrome detection, error location detection, and error correction modules. The simulations revealed that the proposed MBE-DCC resulted in superior performance than conventional LDPC methods.

Author Keywords: Multi-Bit Error Detection and Correction Codes

articleTitle: IoT-Based Employee Location Tracking with Google Maps using STM32 and ESP Microcontroller- A Technological Comparison
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: An employee tracking system helps to track real-time employees' activities inside and outside the premises. The system helps us improve the productivity and efficiency of the work, mainly for the employee who does the traveling job. The designed product can be implemented in schools and colleges to track employees' activities. The cost-effective prototype is technologically advanced using GPS Neo-6 Module and 32-bit Microcontrollers, which must be carried by the employee regularly. The prototype design can easily connect to the Wi-Fi, display the longitude and latitude on the OLED display, Web Brower, and then display the location on Google Maps. The Google map information can show the employee's real-time location and can be accessed anywhere. At last, the prototypes developed are compared in terms of the development cost. Further work is to incorporate tracking the fitness of the employee.

articleTitle: An approach to remove extraneous slices from CT for kidney segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In abdominal computed tomography (CT Scan) images renal segmentation helps nephrologists with clinical diagnoses and medical care planning. The volumetric images' slices irrelevant to the kidney make kidney segmentation difficult. This article presents an approach based on deep-learning to removing extraneous slices, which may help in automatic and manual kidney segmentation.

articleTitle: IOT: Applications, Challenges and Latest Trends
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is envisaged to enhance the living standards with better use of resources and assets. IoT is expected to infiltrate virtually all aspects of our daily life and is a complete package that can assist in sustainable living of the people. Making everything smart facilitates better living, increased protection, cleaner surroundings, time saving mechanisms and peaceful neighborhood. The IoT promises a great future for the internet. Envisioned with the aim to leverage the benefits of IoT and understand its applicability in day-to-day life, this paper, contributes the IoT applications, components, challenges and amalgamation with the latest trends like Blockchain and recommender system.

articleTitle: Square Wave Generator Using Second Generation Current Controlled Conveyor (CCCII)
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: A novel prototype for the generation of square waveform using Second-Generation Current Controlled Conveyor (CCCII) is presented and implemented in this manuscript. The proposed topology has a single active device (CCCII) with only three external passive elements, a grounded capacitor and only two resistors. The functional block is devised and tested using Cadence Orcad tool. It gains the advantage of tunability of frequency by means of bias current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf>) and wide range of tuning is perceived. Supply voltage is fixed at ±2 V. Also the design is experimentally verified exploiting Current Feedback Operational Amplifier (AD844AN), Operational Transconductance Amplifier (LM13700) and few passive elements connected externally on a laboratory setup. Both the experimental and simulated results are depicted and matched with the analysis conceded. Elevated merits of the proposed circuit compared favorably with existing models from open literature. Statistical performance of the design is tested with Montecarlo analysis to establish robustness against resistance tolerance of 5%, the parameters such as Mean, variance and standard deviation are evaluated. Also the maximum power dissipation obtained is ~1.37mW (simulation-platform) and 9.4m W (experimental-platform).

articleTitle: Sensorless FPPT Tracking Mechanism based on Forecasting Data
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The intermittent nature of solar energy with low panel efficiency propel the user to utilize the available solar energy in most efficient way. The Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) enables utmost utilisation of solar power. However, high PV penetration results in several issues such as reverse power flow, overvoltage, frequency fluctuations etc. These problems may be avoided by choosing Flexible Power Point Tracking (FPPT). The operating voltage for MPPT is almost constant. Therefore, once the operating voltage is established, it is maintained at that value irrespective of the level of irradiation. Therefore, costly sensors are not required for implementing the MPPT algorithm. But with FPPT, this is not the case. The operating point varies with the level of irradiation. The knowledge of irradiation from web-based sources enables the user to determine the operating voltage as per the power limit set by the system operator. This paper formulated an algorithm to determine the operating voltage according to the level of irradiation. As the irradiation data is readily made available to the computer, the operating voltage can be predetermined. A simulation is done for a PV system and its operating voltage is calculated to meet the power limit requirements.

articleTitle: Takagi-Sugeno-Kang Fuzzy Controllers for Single Stage Grid Connected PV System
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Grid connected solar power plants are widely established in many places worldwide. Photovoltaic (PV) based grid connected solar plants are attracting recently due to improved in controlling of power converters. Single stage grid connected systems can reduce number of converters connected in power plants which resultant in reduce cost of the system. However, DC to DC converters are generally used in PV systems to enhance the operation of maximum power point for best utilization. The inverters also can be using to extract maximum power from PV systems through new controlling techniques in power electronics devises. Therefore an extra DC to DC converter is not required to make PV at its maximum power point condition. However, this technology can be used for small scale solar power plants since all PV arrays in solar power plant cannot be received same irradiance. Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy controller is having significant priority than proportional plus integral controllers when rapid changes are having in input. Hence, TSK based single stage controller is developed in this paper for grid connected 1MW solar plant. Generally distribution system is connected with unbalanced loads, hence these unbalanced loads will create forcefully unbalanced currents in electrical grid. Unbalanced grid currents further create many problems to other loads. Therefore, the proposed controller is designed to help making grid currents balanced during unbalanced local loads. Further, the inverter can compensate reactive power demanded by local loads to minimize reactive power supplied by grid. On the OPAL-RT platform, extensive data are provided and assessed in order to improve the performance of the proposed controller for a 1MW grid-connected solar plant.

articleTitle: Improvement of LVRT Capability Using PSS for Grid Connected DFIG Based Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This paper mainly aims to investigate the FRT capabilities of a wind power plant connected to the grid. The study introduces an overview of different approaches used to increase Ride-Through (FRT) fault capability in transient WTs based on DFIGs. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the various strategies employed to define the competencies of DFIG WT-based systems with low-voltage travel (LVRT) (WT). The main DFIG-based type-III WT machine is connected to the grid without a digital power interface as the world uses approximately 20-25% of renewable wind energy; consequently, it cannot manage terminal voltage or a reactive electrical output. Unique LVRT approaches were therefore proposed within this document based upon the implementation of other active interface technologies. Today, many techniques to overcome this low-voltage problem by failure are being developed. This article tries to establish these active methods to reduce the gap in overall adaptive performance, controller operational complexity, and economic efficiency by presenting a complete analysis of LVRT strategies for DFIG-based WECS. It also highlights the methods to increase the capacity of LVRT by applying a PSS to configure the relationship in 3 significant areas based on its grid inclusion. FACT device connections are also used in WECS to investigate its efficiency and advantages, including PSS.

articleTitle: Optimal Battery Utilization Based on Weather Forecasting Data Leading to DSI
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Prosumer microgrids are playing a significant role in the electrical grid system. In the recent decade the injection of renewable energy sources is rapidly increasing. Whereas the output power of photovoltaic sources can be influenced by the unpredictable behaviour of weather factors like solar irradiance and ambient temperature. Under such bad weather conditions, the prosumer fulfils their energy gap from the grid system, which causes an extra compulsion to the utility, concerning the grid instability. Also, by using the energy of peak period, consumers have to bear an additional cost. The underlying study identifies the mitigation method and proposed a Smart Battery scheduling system based on weather forecasting data for achieving an affordable and reliable energy supply. The battery scheduling system collects weather information from the weather station through HTTP protocol using thingspeak server. The information gathered can be used to schedule battery charges and establish a demand response scheme. The obtained test result illustrates that the suggested system's forecasting mechanism may significantly reduce grid dependence.

articleTitle: Surveillance using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle for Triggered Activity Capturing
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are being used extensively these days, for various applications such as package delivery, surveillance systems, shooting purposes, and whatnot. Artificial Intelligence in theory talks a lot about search and traversal problems in 2-dimensional space and various algorithms for it. The problem addressed by us is a traversal problem in 3-dimensional space where an unmanned aerial vehicle traverses a dynamic path based on a pre-programmed planner, halts in situations when it faces some hindrance, and reroutes its path to the destination or back to the base station depending upon the situation. In this paper, we propose a surveillance system, where a quick response vehicle acquires the destination address when a trigger is made through GPS by the person in trouble. The drone preplans its path before traversal, traverses the path, and then gets in the vicinity of the person or location from where the emergency signal was triggered. The camera module then captures the images, and the image processing module performs face detection and sends the images to the nearest safety station. In addition to that, if there is only one person detected by the code, the drone performs a 360 rotation to detect the presence of any other animal or bird around and sends the images detected by it so that some suitable action can be taken.

articleTitle: VLSI Implementation of Accuracy Configurable Radix-4 Adder for Digital Image Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The performance of real-world integrated circuits. This work is focused on implementation of novel architecture of Accuracy Configurable Radix-4 Adder (ACRA) utilizing full carry generation (FCG), full sum generation (FSG), half carry generation (HCG), and half sum generation (HSG) blocks, which is named as Hybrid ACRA. Further, the N-bit Hybrid ACRA is implemented using reconfigurable properties with square root additions through modified sum carry selection-based Radix-4 properties. Further, the Carry and Sum output generation consumes less propagation time by utilizing multiplexer switching logic, which selects the full sum bits and carry bits in high-speed manner. The simulation outcomes show that the proposed Hybrid ACRA resulted in improved area, delay and power consumptions as compared to the basics adders and state-of-art approaches.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Sales Analytics in Hypermarket
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) technologies have been extensively used in different aspects of our daily life. One such flourishing aspect is hypermarket which is slowly on the rise for supporting MNCs (Multinational Corporations) and local retailers for increasing their product sales and competitiveness. Having a real-time marketing strategy would certainly direct the retailers to identify their customer's needs faster i.e. which brand their customers prefer more and provide them with information that meets those needs. This research deals with how product sales can be maximized using hypermarket technology thus meeting the customer's demands. This paper proposes a methodology to use ultrasonic sensors as a potential technology in hypermarkets and also to eliminate its limitations using weight transducers.

articleTitle: Applications of Machine Learning in Healthcare: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Traditional research techniques do not work well in the dynamic environment of big data in the healthcare industry, which is characterized by enormous numbers, complexity, and speeds. Methods that can effectively estimate models across massive datasets of medical usage data, health findings, private computer data, and records from many other sources are critically needed. The goal of machine learning (ML), a branch of artificial intelligence (AI), is to increase the efficiency and precision of healthcare. Applications of machine learning (ML) are significantly changing the healthcare industry. Big data and improved computing power present an opportunity to apply ML algorithms to benefit healthcare. The healthcare curriculum has to incorporate a variety of ML-related topics so that medical personnel may successfully direct and analyze research in this field. Machine learning will revolutionize nearly every aspect of the healthcare profession as it stands today. To understand the various healthcare applications of this technology, it is necessary to examine the research that has been done in this area. This enumerative article provides a thorough review of machine learning in healthcare, covering its terminology, basic concepts, and present and potential uses.

articleTitle: Differentiating S1, S2 Noises from Abnormal Heart Sounds Generated in Closure of Atrioventricular and Semilunar Valves using MFCC and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Heart Sounds are generated by heartbeats in the form of noises. Each beat in a healthy human produces two normal heart sounds, which are sometimes referred to as a lub and a dub (or dup). For example, S1 and S2 heart sounds are produced by the closing of both atrioventricular and semilunar valves. This heart sound dataset has been collected in real-world circumstances and frequently incorporates various types of background noises. Differences in heart sounds that correspond to different cardiac symptoms might be quite subtle and difficult to distinguish. To overcome this type of situation, a deep learning-based classification model named long short-term memory (LSTM) with RNN (Recurrent Neural Network) technology has been proposed in this project. This approach featured with unique additive gradient structure that can differentiate the heart sounds i.e. S1 and S2 from abnormal noises. Along with Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC) at the pre-processing step, ensures the patients' successful representation of heart sounds present in audio files into their respective frequency domain forms. Although, MFCC can move forward with four basic processes that include Fourier Transform (FT), mapping to Mel Scale, use of triangular windows, and log of each Mel frequency. Moreover, it may be difficult to solve problems like classifying heart sound that requires long-term memory due to having gradient problems present in RNN. Such problems can be overcome by applying both RNN and LSTM techniques as LSTM maintains the information in the memory cell for a longer period. To restrict the amount of data passed through the cell, this proposed model uses three sigmoid gates and one tanh layer. When information enters into the memory, when to output, and it is forgotten, that is controlled by a set of gates that allow for greater control of the gradient flow and maintenance of long-range dependencies. This RNN-LSTM model has been successfully implemented and differentiated heart sounds with a greater test accuracy result of 80 percent.

articleTitle: Feature Selection for Lung and Breast Cancer Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Early detection of cancer is essential for a favorable prognosis because it is the biggest cause of death globally. After lung cancer, breast cancer ranks as the second most prevalent cause of death. With the fast expansion of the populace, the risk of mortality from lung and breast cancer is increasing rapidly. Early cancer prediction is challenging because there are few signs of this disease at an early stage. An automated sickness identification system provide accurate, efficient and quick response while assisting medical workers in identifying disorders and decreases death rates. In this research, we proposed PSO-FS (particle swarm optimization-based feature selection) method to select the features for several machine learning techniques to categorize accessible lung and breast cancer data. The best classifier approach for predicting both cancer diseases is considered to be the forest (RF) and deep learning (DL) classifier, which has high accuracy of 99.7% and 97%, respectively. Hence feature selection approach can increase performance by selecting only significant features.

articleTitle: A comparative review on electric vehicles and hybrid vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Health concerns caused due to environmental pollution have raised the need for an environment-friendly and fuel-efficient solution to the transportation system. The continuous use of traditional vehicles run by fossil fuels has degraded the environment from its harmful emissions. The emission of Green House Gases (GHGs) and other pollutants results in global warming and ozone layer depletion. To mitigate these problems, there require some assured and short-run solutions to handle the current situation. The use of an Electric Vehicle (EV) is such a solution which reduces the on-road pollution but the batteries are being charged from electricity which is generated using fossil fuels which causes pollution to the source stations. The use of some alternative and renewable sources of energy like fuel cell and solar power, to charge the vehicle with a combination of EVs and ICEVs reduces the pollution level and make it environment friendly. Slowly, it can be shifted towards pure electric vehicles which are run by purely some renewable sources of energy. This paper presents a comparison and classifications of EVs and Hybrid Electric vehicles (HEVs) in the current scenario that will help the EVs enthusiast for further research in this area.

articleTitle: Ensembled Transfer Learning Models for Real Time Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Face recognition application is applied in several fields including authentication through biometrics, security-enhancing applications, controlling automobiles, finding mental health, and person/people detection. Still face recognition remains a challenge due to variance in effects of the images such as illumination variation, poses, occlusions, varied facial expressions and etc. Although many techniques such as iris and fingerprint scanning yield prominent accuracy, face recognition is an admirable technique that is applied for many real-time recognitions and is a method of identification that is human-centric. Recognizing the human face plays a significant part in behavior analysis since most of the features can be extracted from facial features. In this paper, the face recognition using Convolution Neural Network(CNN) with its transfer learning architectures such as Visual Geometry Group, VGG16, InceptionResNet, DenseNet121, and MobileNet is demonstrated with its performance for the custom dataset built on 12 different human faces. Stacked the four models and compared the accuracy. HaarCascade classifier using Frontal face is used for experimenting. In this work, face detection and face recognition in video surveillance is explored. More significantly, the system executes the recognition process for the mentioned architectures and the results obtained prove VGG16 architecture provides better accuracy compared with other models.

articleTitle: Whale Optimization based MPPT of Single Stage Grid Connected PV System with $\mathbf{H}\infty$ Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)

authors.preferredName: D. Nitya Santoshi Rupa Priyanka Malla

abstract: Many maximum power point tracking (MPPT) techniques are widely used to harvest maximum energy from Photovoltaic (PV) panels. Among those perturb and observe (P&O) method is an effective technique to work in the condition of uniform irradiance. However, an optimization algorithm is required to identify the global maximum location (GML) among the existence of many local maximum locations during partial shading conditions. The Whale inspired algorithm is a famous optimization technique to identify GML quickly as compared with many optimization algorithms. Usually a single stage grid connected PV system is a more efficient and economical method in medium power generations due to absence of an extra DC to DC converter. The interfacing inverter between PV and grid itself is working as a MPPT converter by regulating DC link voltage at GML. In this scenario, a whale inspired optimization technique can help to harvest more energy by a proper inverter controller. The H∞ controller can help to get fast response as well as to make the system more stabilized. Therefore, in this paper a novel controller is proposed for the inverter to work as a single stage grid connected PV system. The quality of power can also be supplied to the grid by the proposed controller. Extensive results based on Hardware-in the-Loop (HIL) are presented in this work on the platform of OPAL-RT technologies.

articleTitle: A Study on the Impact of 5G in Defense and Security
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: 5G which stands for fifth generation wireless network. Fifth-generation technology is a new standard for broadband cellular networks as it is designed to connect devices and everyone to each other and aimed to provide higher bandwidth with extremely low latency. 5G networks are now being evaluated in several sites throughout the world, with commercial use likely to commence in India in early 2022. This article delves at the potential applications of 5G technology in the sphere of military and conflict situations. After a quick rundown of 5G technologies and how it works, a detailed literature review of research done by authors in the field of 5G with in time span of six years is done along with stating some gaps in their research papers and then a detailed discussion about different key technologies used in 5G network such as - mm Wave, MIMO, Hentet's, D2D Communication, SDN, NFV are talked through. This paper focuses on challenges in deployment of 5G technology. After which it has an incredibly detailed discussion about privacy and security challenges which are linked with 5G because of using foreign equipment and then it provides workable solutions to the privacy and securitychallenges.

articleTitle: A Detailed Review on Battery Cooling Systems for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: As concerns about the environment and fuel usage have increased in recent years, electric vehicles shown to have a huge advantage over conventional vehicles. Lithium-ion batteries, which have a high energy density and a long service life are currently used in these electric vehicles. However, a significant issue has been raised by a rise in battery temperature, which has increased the demand for battery thermal management system development. Therefore, choosing an efficient cooling method for the battery packs in electric vehicles is vital. Additionally, for improved performance, minimal maintenance costs, and greater safety, the battery's operating temperature range is around 10 to 50°C. If a battery is not used within this temperature range, its performance may degrade, which might lead to thermal runaway.

articleTitle: Fault Prevention in DC Microgrids: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The development of DC microgrids has received considerable interest in both academia and industry over the last decade. DC microgrids have proven to be more reliable and efficient than alternating current microgrids in terms of dependability, integration of renewable energy sources, connectivity of alternating current loads, efficiency and control simplicity. Regardless of the major benefits of dc microgrids, building and installing a suitable protection system for these systems continues to be a considerable undertaking. The difficulty arises from the quick growth in fault current in DC, which must be destroyed immediately when zero crossings do not occur naturally, which could result in sustained arcs. The difficulties associated with DC microgrid protection are examined in this paper from a variety of perspectives, including fault detection methods, ground systems, dc fault current characteristics, fault location methods and protective devices. A thorough examination of each section has been carried out.

articleTitle: Review on Scenario of Wind Power Generation and Control
publicationTitle: 2022 1st IEEE International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This era brings RE ascent more popular in energy generations evolve response in enhancing concern towards environmental issues. Among all RE sources wind energy becomes more attractive in the sense of nonhazardous, cleanest and most cost-effective source of energy. This 20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> century appeals the risk of shortage in fossil fuel, pollutions, carbon dioxide emissions and the surge of power demands. This develops a hope to settle our future energy demands to be recovered the wind energy can play the vital role in this aspect. Fulfilling the clean energy source, this renewable source can also be a part of growth in energy sector. This review work presents the worldwide generations of wind power and its control considering all constraints and parameters.
